newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics rises on Cardinal deal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics rises on Cardinal deal.

text.p: Shares of U.S. Robotics Corp rose on Monday after a competitor in the computer modem market said it will use U.S. Robotics' high-speed Internet connection technology in its new modems.

Cardinal Technologies Inc said its new 33.6 kilobit per second modem can be upgraded to 56 kbps and 125 kbps Integrated Services Digital Networks, or ISDN, for faster Internet connections. Cardinal said it will use U.S. Robotics' "x2" technology.

"The Cardinal thing is pretty exciting because the more vendors they can sign up to use the U.S. Robotics' implementation, the more likely that will be the standard," said Jim McIlree, an analyst for Southcoast Capital.
Texas Instruments Inc is building chips based on the x2 technology, and U.S. Robotics will receive royalties.
Shares of U.S. Robotics traded four higher at 68.
